## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete user need, trigger, and resulting behavior.

## Implementation and tradeoffs

Explain the choices a reviewer needs to assess. Link a real issue if one exists.

## Validation

List commands actually run and observed outcomes. Include keyboard, reduced motion, mobile, WebGL fallback, and screenshots when relevant. Clearly identify checks not run and why.

## Documentation, assets, and migration

Link updated docs. Record new asset provenance, dependencies, breaking changes, and any migration steps. State remaining limitations.
